heading: Our Custom Design Process
intro: Five simple steps to get from initial concept to a fully priced, engineered kit.

steps.title: Pay the fee
steps.description: Secure your design package to officially kick off the process.

steps.title: Interview & Education
steps.description: We consult with you extensively, providing money-saving education to optimize your build.

steps.title: Receive first design
steps.description: Get your initial architectural layout and exterior 3D renders based on our consultation.

steps.title: Make changes
steps.description: Two rounds of updates are included. Additional updates are just $45 per revision.

steps.title: Price your total kit
steps.description: Once the design is finalized, we provide a comprehensive, engineered kit quote.
